نستغبي (form X)
# نَسْتَغْبِي (nastaḡbī) /nas.taɣ.biː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# نَسْتَغْبِيَ (nastaḡbiya) /nas.taɣ.bi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
